component.name: Surf Accounting
component.summary: Local-first accounting, invoicing and delivery management

description.p: Surf is a local-first accounting and logistics application. It keeps a strict double-entry General Ledger in SQLite on your device (no cloud account required) and produces invoices, delivery orders, estimates and financial reports from a single streamlined desktop UI.

ul.li: Sales invoices with live tax and discount math, PDF/PNG exports
Linked Delivery Orders with status tracking and printable slips
Vendor bills with accounts-payable posting and payment tracking
Product & service catalog linked to GL accounts
Recurring invoice templates with weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly cadence
Strict double-entry bookkeeping: every posted document is balanced
Financial reports: Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Trial Balance
Daily FX rate feed (IRR base) via tgju.org
Device-to-device sync bundles for offline/LAN use

description.p: Purchases & Expenses module: vendor bills, vendor directory and a product/services catalog wired into invoice building; XDG-compliant data directory for sandboxed installs.
